turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until 4:40, so let's not waste it. Why was there a zero in the gradebook before anyone called me?
I spoke with the vice principal before you came in.
The vice principal. So someone else has seen this before I have, and I'm writing that down. What did you tell them, and did anyone speak to Owen before the zero went in?
She's backing me completely. Policy is policy, and it isn't up to you.
"Policy is policy." Good, because I have it printed, and 4.2 says a parent is contacted before any mark consequence is entered, which nobody did. Which section of your policy lets a zero go in first?
So frankly, this meeting is a courtesy.

"A courtesy." Procedure 4.2 says the meeting is offered before the mark goes in, so it's a requirement you met a week late. I'm writing that down, and if you have nothing else, I'm going to the principal when we're done.
